title: Quarter-Wave Seeded 36-Layer Dual-Stopband with ±8 nm Bounded Perturbation
scientific_hypothesis: Anchoring the search near theoretical quarter-wave interference conditions at both stopband center wavelengths (360 nm UV, 1055 nm NIR) with bounded ±8 nm perturbation will reduce invalid candidate ratio and enable optimizer to focus on admittance matching rather than discovering feasible geometries, improving target score consistency above 0.85.
design_principle: Modified Quarter-Wavelength Optimization from evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:110520903:s2chunk:110520903:15:2261:1134512e8e2ab66f: Start with quarter-wave optical thickness layers for high-reflection bands, then vary optical thickness through optimization. Alternating high-low index Bragg stack structure provides dual stopband suppression.
proposed_topology: 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence. Layer 1=Ta2O5, Layer 2=SiO2, continuing alternation through Layer 36=SiO2. Total finite-layer count: 36.
soft_objectives: minimize mean transmittance in 355-365 nm band
minimize mean transmittance in 1030-1080 nm band
maximize mean transmittance in 420-700 nm band
maintain individual layer thickness within 20-350 nm bounds
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds 20-350 nm respect deposition constraints
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for high-reflection bands
Bragg reflector interference conditions at multiple wavelengths
known_risks: Quarter-wave initialization may trap optimizer in local minimum
Passband ripple may increase with more layers
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 multilayer filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Initialize thicknesses using quarter-wave conditions: Ta2O5 layers at d=λ_UV/(4*n_Ta2O5)≈39 nm for λ_UV=360 nm, SiO2 layers at d=λ_NIR/(4*n_SiO2)≈176 nm for λ_NIR=1055 nm. Apply alternating sequence starting with Ta2O5. Constrain optimization to ±8 nm Gaussian perturbation around these base values during candidate generation. Layer thickness bounds: 20-350 nm. Optimize for: minimize mean transmittance at 355-365 nm, minimize mean transmittance at 1030-1080 nm, maximize mean transmittance at 420-700 nm. Use gradient_thickness optimizer with bounded noise initialization. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Replace unstructured random initialization from prior route_03 iterations with deterministic quarter-wave seeding at λ₁=360 nm and λ₂=1055 nm per feedback directive. Prior iteration_03 achieved 0.9405 with 36-layer structure but used less structured initialization. This refinement anchors search near theoretical interference conditions to reduce invalid ratio.
